rules.statement: The interest created by the joint will of Don Siman de Silva and Nona Baba was not a fidei commissum, but rather an immediate gift to their seven children with restrictions on alienation.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion that the deed does not create a fidei commission Each of the seven children take a seventh in fee, no trust is created in them for any one else; the donors clearly expressed 296 their desire that the lands should not be sold or burdened by their children"
